works.version: Aage Bohr, The Coupling of Nuclear Surface Oscillations to the Motion of Individual Nucleons, Dan. Mat. Fys. Medd. 26 no. 14 (1952), institutional scan
works.lineage: Original theoretical work. Related to the 1953 theory development without supplying an independent experiment.
scope: PDF 1–2 cover and contents; 3–6 introduction; 7–13 classical surface; 14–22 quantization; 22–24 particle motion; 25–39 coupling and perturbations; 40 references.

Prior deep reading and current page checks together cover the work. PDF 13 connects inertia with beta squared and principal axes; PDF 21 distinguishes the pure collective selection rule and the I=0 Legendre reduction; PDF 27–28 adds the combined particle-surface constraints.
works.gap: Physical scope, formal conditions and cited historical comparisons retained. No claims of modern experimental calibration, rereading every reference, or complete Bohr-Mottelson 1953 coverage.
